readme:
# CWJobs UK IT & Tech Jobs Scraper

Scrape IT contract and permanent jobs from [CWJobs.co.uk](https://www.cwjobs.co.uk/), the UK's specialist board for technology recruitment. Paste a search URL or a keyword and location; get every listing back as structured JSON with employer, salary, IR35 status, day rate, tech skills, contract length and full description.

## What it does

Pulls live UK IT and tech vacancies from CWJobs search results, deduplicates them, and pushes them to your Apify dataset. Handles pagination automatically up to your result cap. Optionally opens each job's detail page to add structured salary ranges, IR35 status, contract length in months, workplace type (remote / hybrid / onsite), tech skill tags and full ad copy.

Fields you get per job:
- Job title, employer name, employer logo
- Location, country, salary (min, max, currency, period)
- Rate type (annual, daily, hourly, monthly)
- Employment type (permanent, contract, temporary)
- Workplace type (remote, hybrid, onsite)
- IR35 status (inside, outside, undetermined) for contract roles
- Contract length in months when the ad specifies it
- Tech skills array (Java, AWS, Kubernetes, React, Python, etc.)
- Sector (Cybersecurity, Data Science, DevOps, Frontend, etc.)
- Description, direct application URL, posted date
- Deep-employer mode: employer's company-jobs page listing, company website hint, address (from PDP schema.org jobLocation)

## Input

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `searchUrls` | array | Copy any CWJobs search URL (e.g. `/jobs/java-developer/in-london`). Filters preserved. |
| `searchQueries` | array | Keyword queries (for example `java developer`, `devops engineer`, `data scientist`). |
| `location` | string | UK city, region or postcode. Applied to keyword queries. |
| `maxResults` | integer | Total cap across all queries. |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | Cap per individual query. |
| `includeJobDetails` | boolean | Open each PDP for structured salary, IR35, contract length and skills. |
| `includeCompanyDetails` | boolean | Also fetch the employer's totaljobs.com/jobs/{slug} company-jobs page for the About-us summary and a list of the employer's other open roles. Implies `includeJobDetails=true`. Dedup by employer id within a run. Default false. |
| `maxConcurrency` | integer | Concurrent detail requests (1 to 20). |

## Output fields

Every dataset row has a stable schema documented in the Output tab. Key derived fields:

- `employment_type`: permanent, contract, temporary
- `rate_type`: annual, daily, hourly, monthly
- `workplace_type`: remote, hybrid, onsite
- `ir35_status`: inside, outside, undetermined (populated when IR35 is mentioned in the ad)
- `contract_length_months`: numeric, extracted from phrases like "6 month contract" or "12-week engagement"
- `skills`: array of normalised tech tags (Java, Python, AWS, Kubernetes, React, .NET, etc.)
- `sector`: narrowed sub-sector (Cybersecurity, Data Science, DevOps, Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, Mobile, QA / Testing, Cloud, Networking, IT Support, Project Management, Product / BA, IT / Software)
- `salary_range`: object with `min`, `max`, `currency`, `period`

**Employer / company profile (`includeCompanyDetails: true`):**
- `company_about`: About-us summary (from og:description on the employer's totaljobs.com page)
- `company_website`: Employer company-jobs page URL from PDP schema.org hiringOrganization.url
- `company_address_city`, `company_address_country`: From PDP schema.org jobLocation.address
- `company_active_jobs_count`, `company_active_jobs`: Count + list (title + job_url) of the employer's other open roles
- `company_phone`, `company_email`, `company_address_street`, `company_address_postcode`: Not exposed on cwjobs/totaljobs; always null

## Use with an AI agent (MCP)

Connect this actor to Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client to have your agent pull UK IT jobs on demand.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "cwjobs-uk-scraper": {
      "url": "https://mcp.apify.com/?actors=santamaria-automations/cwjobs-uk-scraper"
    }
  }
}
```

Example prompt: "Find 30 Java developer contract jobs on CWJobs in London that are outside IR35 with a day rate over £500, return company, salary, contract length and posted date."

## Why this scraper

Built HTTP-only in Go for consistent speed and low cost. Uses schema.org JobPosting data on every detail page, so structured salary and dates come straight from the site's own markup instead of guesswork. Derives IR35 status, contract length and tech skills from the full ad text with UK IT contracting vocabulary (inside / outside IR35, deemed inside via umbrella, month or week engagement lengths).

## Common use cases

- Recruitment agencies tracking new IT vacancies daily
- Contract recruiters benchmarking day rates by tech stack and IR35 status
- IT staffing firms building account lists of hiring companies by tech skill
- Market intelligence on which UK employers hire for AWS, Kubernetes, .NET or Java at scale
- Researchers studying inside-vs-outside IR35 rate deltas since HMRC reforms

## Notes and limits

- Coverage: UK IT and tech vacancies posted to CWJobs.co.uk. Sister board of TotalJobs, detail pages are hosted on totaljobs.com but linked from CWJobs listings.
- Salary field is normalised to `min`, `max`, `currency` and `period` when the ad exposes numbers; when the ad only lists "Competitive" or "Undisclosed" the range comes through as `null`.
- IR35 status is populated only when the ad or salary text explicitly mentions IR35. Older permanent listings will show `null`.
- Contract length parses `6 month contract`, `12 months`, `3-month`, and `N weeks` formats and normalises to months. Ranges like `6-12 months` return the first value.
- Skill detection is keyword-based on the ad text; a job that mentions Java and AWS in its description will get both tags. Unusual capitalisation of `C#`, `C++` and `.NET` is handled explicitly.
